Ben / team / Elena —

Reviewed the redline. Summary below and proposed next steps:

Summary of material points:
- Data residency: we can commit to US-region processing for account-scoped workloads. We will not commit to geo-fenced backups without an additional controls addendum (can be discussed).
- HIPAA appendix: we accept standard BAA language with the following negotiated tweaks in Section HIPAA-3 (audit scope) — limit audit frequency to annually unless there is a reasonable cause.
- Audit rights / logs: we will provide SOC 2 report + selected system logs; customer-specific log exports are available on request but will be delivered via secure transfer with a 14-business-day turnaround.
- Retention / deletion: retention for backups is 90 days by default for the tenant; can extend with a contractual SLO for an additional fee.

Proposed edits we will upload as a clean DPA with redlines accepted and show markup for the HIPAA appendix.

Execution plan:
1) Redwood prepares a clean DPA reflecting the accepted edits + HIPAA appendix (Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Clean_v3.docx).
2) Send DocuSign envelope to GreenRoute (Elena + Sam) with Marissa as Redwood signatory.
3) If GreenRoute requires countersignature, Ben will coordinate commercial countersign with the procurement team.

Elena — please confirm: DocuSign OK? If yes we will issue the envelope today and target signature by Thursday. If procurement needs countersign, please indicate who will sign on your side and whether you require an executed PDF first.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Legal | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Clean_v3.docx)
